static_traits.name: Ke Kai
static_traits.social_status: Keeping distance from friends who do not understand industry pressure; has a few friends in the modeling industry to talk with, but has not yet revealed self-esteem issues to them
static_traits.medical_history: Had urinary-system cancer at 18 and recovered; no prior psychotherapy or psychological problems; currently in Good health
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous at the first session, but high cooperation, clear expression, coherent logic, a positive attitude, and willingness to try cognitive restructuring

basic_info.main_problem: Repeatedly frustrated in maintaining a low-carb diet, frequently engages in negative self-labeling because of dietary mistakes (such as 'I am a weak coward'), affecting confidence and professional focus.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to stop seeing myself as a failure when I make mistakes, rebuild confidence, so I can focus on my career.
growth_experiences: Had urinary-system cancer at 18 and beat the disease; stayed healthy since, no psychotherapy history.

After entering the Hollywood modeling industry, in recent months under a high-pressure environment, finding it hard to persistently follow a low-carb diet plan; after dietary slips, negative self-labels and self-criticism frequently appear, gradually affecting professional focus and daily self-care.

core_beliefs: I am weak / not strong enough
I am not suited for this industry
I will fail in the end

special_situations.event: Each time Deviating from the low-carbon diet plan(e.g. eating food not in the plan)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot fully and consistently follow the diet plan, it means I have no willpower; I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to control diet more strictly, seeks comfort and reassurance from others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have no willpower; I am cowardly, a coward

special_situations.event: Seeing peer friends or colleagues who seem to 'all stick to the plan and be in good shape'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others can all do it but I cannot, it proves I am inferior to them and not suited for this industry
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am inferior to them; I am not suited to be a model

special_situations.event: In high-pressure stages such as auditions or work preparation, dietary adherence becomes harder
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: People truly suited for this industry stay perfectly disciplined under pressure; if I cannot, I will never succeed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressures oneself with negative labels, seeks others' assurance

special_situations.event: After a dietary slip-up in front of friends or colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they see my mistakes, they will look down on me and think I am useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Contacts friends less, avoids social settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen as a disciplined, successful person (to gain acceptance from the industry and peers)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and imperfection will invite others' contempt and rejection, thus negating my worth
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and avoids failure through harsh self-demands and self-criticism
Avoids socializing to reduce the risk of being judged
Seeking others' reassurance to temporarily ease unease and shame

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough weak person who could fail at any moment
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh, critical judges who may negate me at any time (peers/industry)
Bystanders/friends who do not understand industry pressure

manifestations: Keeping distance from friends who do not understand industry pressure
Avoiding social interaction after diet slip-ups
Negative self-labels weaken the sense of self-worth and purpose
Finds it hard to see effort and progress after setbacks

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse originally intended to be expressed or sought outward, and instead does it to herself (turning energy from outward to inward).
manifestations: After a diet slip, turns stress and frustration into harsh self-criticism and negative labels
Reduces communication with others and internalizes emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Worrying others will look down on me, attributing self-shame to 'they will negate me'
Assuming others have negative views of me when they look Good

contact_model.definition: The individual has maladaptive self-Reflection with excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, being overly careful about contact.
manifestations: Frequently using self-deprecating language (like 'I have no willpower')
Over-evaluating myself in social and professional situations, causing Withdrawal

positive_force: Has clear desire and drive toward career goals
Willing to seek help and try cognitive restructuring and self-compassion exercises
Positive attitude toward counseling, able to notice and willing to record negative automatic thoughts
Has a few peer resources in the industry to talk with
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking that binds self-worth to perfect self-discipline
Frequent self-labeling and catastrophic future Anticipation
Excessively compares with others, seeks external reassurance but with limited effect
Social avoidance causing Decreased support and increased Loneliness
Under professional stress, self-blame escalates and mood swings affect action

target_behavior.behavior: Harsh negative self-labeling and self-criticism after a dietary slip
antecedent: Deviating from the low-carbon diet plan
In high-pressure phases like audition/work preparation
Comparison arises after seeing peers stick to their plans
target_behavior.core_reason: Binds self-worth to perfect self-discipline; catastrophizes failure in order to gain industry recognition, lacking self-compassion
target_behavior.function: Tries to strengthen self-control through self-punishment while avoiding shame and disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged self-confidence,Decreased motivation,Reduced focus at work,Emotional fluctuations intensifying

target_behavior.behavior: Seeking comfort and reassurance from others
antecedent: Self-doubt and unease after diet slip-ups
Feels pressure and tension after comparing with peers
target_behavior.core_reason: Strong need for external validation, lacking a stable internal source of self-affirmation
target_behavior.function: Briefly gaining comfort and approval to ease Anxiety and uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Developing dependence on others' reassurance, long-term difficulty in establishing stable self-worth, negative self-labels persist

antecedent: Worries others will see one's mistakes and evaluate them
Shame and tension before interacting with friends who do not understand industry pressure
target_behavior.core_reason: Anticipating being looked down on or negated (mind-reading and personalization tendencies), Withdrawing out of Self-protection
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential negative evaluation and uncomfortable emotions
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, Increased sense of loneliness, problem maintained
